title: Mapping Auricular Vagus Nerve Circuitry
official: Auricular Vagal Nerve Stimulation for Gastric and Brain Outcomes
summary: This study will determine how noninvasive nerve stimulation affects human brain, stomach, and autonomic activity.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults 18-65
* Functional dyspepsia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any condition contraindicating an fMRI brain scan
